name: Sierra
tagline: Enterprise AI agents for customer experience
description: Sierra builds branded conversational AI agents for enterprise customer experience. Founded by Bret Taylor (ex-Salesforce co-CEO) and Clay Bavor (ex-Google), the company raised $950M at a $15B valuation in May 2026 with a reported ~$150M ARR. Pricing is outcomes-based — customers pay per resolved interaction rather than per seat.
pricingDetails: Outcomes-based: charged per resolved interaction. No public list price.
